case_title: BILAFER, RICHARD DBA B & A TOWING VS. GOLDEN GATE BRIDGE DISTRICT

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-08-2009 - JUDGMENT. (CLERK-BETH WILBER, ROOM 103)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BILAFER, RICHARD DBA B & A TOWING RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT GOLDEN GATE BRIDGE DISTRICT $2,571.78 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,621.78, ** AS STATED AT THE HEARING, I TREATED PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AS AN APPLICATION TO REVIEW AND REVERSE DEFENDANT'S DENIAL OF PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST FOR LEAVE TO PRESENT A LATE ADMINISTRATIVE CLAIM, AND I AM SATISFIED THAT THE INTERESTS OF JUSTICE REQUIRE THAT I REVERSE THAT DENIAL. I CREDIT TESTIMONY OF ROBERT BILAFER REGARDING HOW THE ACCIDENT OCCURRED AND FURTHER FIND, BASED ON VIEWING THE EXEMPLAR BUS, THAT PLAINTIFF'S VERSION OF THE ACCIDENT IS BOTH PLAUSIBLE AND NOT PHYSICALLY IMPOSSIBLE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
